title: Nathan’s serious mass program
desc: Dive into Nathan’s Serious Mass Program, a high-intensity, week-long regimen designed for serious lifters ready to pack on muscle. With six days of focused training, each 90-minute session targets your upper body through a variety of machine and free weight exercises, including Chest Supported Rows and Lat Pulldowns. This advanced program maximizes muscle engagement and promotes growth, making it ideal for those looking to elevate their strength game. Get ready to push your limits and see real results!
